points.description: Correct solution with every step valid and final answer 1487. Method: factor 1547 = 7·13·17, then count the integers from 1 to 1997 not divisible by 7, 13 or 17 (inclusion-exclusion, or a valid alternative such as using φ(1547)=1152 over periods of 1547 plus a remainder count). Any step that is wrong, or a final answer other than 1487, earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark (1) only if all steps are valid and the final answer is 1487. Any wrong step or wrong final answer earns 0. A different valid method that reaches 1487 earns the mark.
